subject: Listing credit reconciliation & reseller evidence workflow
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@cloudland.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cloudland.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Listing credit reconciliation for marketplace private offers

Sergio —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is ready to move forward on the private offer but we need to lock down the mechanics for the listing credit on marketplace SKUs (AWS + GCP) and how that flows through to our reseller partner. Two specific asks from our side: 

1) What evidence does Redwood require to certify that the reseller actually received the listing credit (invoice flow, proof of payment, reseller statement)?
2) How will the credit be reflected on Redwood invoices vs marketplace settlement? We need to reconcile on our side to avoid double-crediting.

We have an internal approval window that closes next Friday, so a clear checklist and timeline would be ideal. I've looped in procurement to share PO timing.

Attaching our initial procurement template for visibility.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Nguyen
Sourcing Lead, Cloudland Systems
[attachment: Cloudland_procurement_template.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@cloudland.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing credit reconciliation for marketplace private offers

Claire — thanks for the quick note and the template. High level answer up front: we can support a reconciled listing-credit flow that ties a Redwood invoice line to the marketplace private-offer settlement, and we will require specific evidence from the reseller to close the loop. See the proposed workflow below and the attached matrix.

Proposed workflow (summary):
- Step 1: Customer signs private offer and issues PO to Redwood (or to reseller if pre-agreed).
- Step 2: Redwood issues invoice for the net amount (list price minus listing credit). We will include a dedicated invoice code for listing-credit reversals to make reconciliation explicit.
- Step 3: Reseller provides evidence package after marketplace settlement: invoice from reseller showing the passed-through credit, payment remittance, and reseller-signed certificate (see template).
- Step 4: Ops verifies evidence and issues an accounting credit or routing instruction to customer/reseller depending on what the PO indicates.

Key asks from your side: whether Cloudland wants the credit applied as an up-front invoice reduction (preferred) or as a post-settlement rebate. Up-front reduces invoice complexity on your side but requires the private-offer mapping to be final at signing.

Attachments I've included: redwood_listing_credit_matrix.xlsx (mapping per SKU + suggested invoice codes) and reseller_evidence_template.docx (what we need from the reseller).

Open items:
- Confirm whether PO will be made out to Redwood or to the reseller (this changes routing and timing).
- Confirm target reseller margin pass-through percentage (we do not calculate margins for the partner but can encode the agreed % in our invoice code).

If it's helpful, Ben can run a quick example calculator showing net economics under both up-front vs post-rebate approaches. 

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive — Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_listing_credit_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)] [attachment: reseller_evidence_template.docx (docx)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@cloudland.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing credit reconciliation for marketplace private offers

Quick follow-up on the economics/questions:

Claire — two operational clarifications that drive how we annotate invoices and set GL routing:
1) Invoice recipient: Will Cloudland invoice Redwood for the purchase and then pay the reseller separately, or will the reseller invoice Cloudland and we route the reseller pass-through? Practically, if the PO is to Redwood we can apply the credit up-front on the Redwood invoice and include a line-item that documents the % passed to reseller. If PO is to reseller, we need reseller invoices for settlement reconciliation.
2) Channel margin signal: can you confirm the percent of the listing credit that should be treated as reseller pass-through vs Cloudland retention (e.g., 80/20 split)? We don't want to guess — put the number here and we'll bake it into the HubSpot deal.

For CLD-2028-347 I modeled two examples (attached snapshot in the HubSpot link) showing the accounting impact under both flows. If you prefer, we can lock the approach to up-front credit now and run a true-up 30 days after marketplace settlement to handle exceptions.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Director, North America
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@cloudland.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing credit reconciliation for marketplace private offers

Adding ops checklist and required evidence items so procurement has clarity. If we follow the up-front credit route we need slightly different artifacts than the post-rebate path — both are supported but the paperwork differs.

Required evidence (minimum):
- Reseller-signed invoice showing the listing credit passed to end customer (PDF)
- Reseller remittance advice or payment confirmation from marketplace settlement (screenshot or CSV)
- Reseller-signed reseller_evidence_template.docx (signed PDF)
- PO matching: PO number present on all documents or clear mapping table (we'll provide the mapping code)

Ops steps and timeline (if PO to Redwood, preferred):
Day 0: PO signed and sent to Redwood (apply up-front credit on invoice).
Day 1-3: Redwood issues invoice with listing-credit line and sends invoice routing instructions to Cloudland finance.
Day 15-30: Marketplace settlement occurs; reseller submits evidence package.
Day 30-45: Ops verifies and, if mismatch, triggers a true-up invoice (to Redwood or reseller depending on routing).

If PO is to reseller, we will require the reseller evidence earlier (before applying up-front credit) and will delay the invoice reduction until evidence is validated.

Action items for Redwood: provide final invoice code mapping and a sample invoice PDF. Action items for Cloudland: confirm PO recipient and the percent split for reseller pass-through.

Thanks — happy to own the ops verification and coordinate with accounting once you confirm flow.

Irene Choi
Deal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@cloudland.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Listing credit reconciliation for marketplace private offers

Sergio / Ben / Irene —

Thanks for the detail and the templates. Cloudland will: 
- Issue the PO to Redwood (preferred for simpler internal processing). PO attached.
- We agree to an 85/15 split (85% passed to reseller, 15% retained to cover our integration work).
- We'll complete the reseller evidence request: reseller will provide signed invoice + remittance after marketplace settlement.

Next steps from our side: procurement will upload the PO to the DocuSign envelope (link below) and route to our finance for payment instructions. Please confirm the final invoice code mapping and send a sample Redwood invoice that includes the listing-credit line item and GL code to use. Once we receive the sample we will close approvals and expect signatures next week.
